# Other Constants

![Other Constants function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/numeric/34-autres-constantes.svg)

[Numeric functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Opens mathematical and physical constants for the diagram.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**Autres constantes**

Ouvre les constantes mathematiques et physiques du diagramme.

</details>

## Browse this palette

This entry opens a palette folder; it is not an executable dataflow function.

| Entry | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Positive Infinity](other_constants/positive_infinity.md) | Places the positive infinity constant on the diagram. |
| [Negative Infinity](other_constants/negative_infinity.md) | Places the negative infinity constant on the diagram. |
| [Pi](other_constants/pi.md) | Places the Pi constant on the diagram. |
| [Pi / 2](other_constants/pi_over_two.md) | Places one half of Pi on the diagram. |
| [2 Pi](other_constants/two_pi.md) | Places two times Pi on the diagram. |
| [1 / Pi](other_constants/one_over_pi.md) | Places the reciprocal of Pi on the diagram. |
| [e](other_constants/e.md) | Places Euler's number on the diagram. |
| [1 / e](other_constants/one_over_e.md) | Places the reciprocal of Euler's number on the diagram. |
| [Machine Epsilon](other_constants/machine_epsilon.md) | Places the floating-point machine epsilon on the diagram. |
| [Ln 10](other_constants/ln_ten.md) | Places the natural logarithm of ten on the diagram. |
| [Ln 2](other_constants/ln_two.md) | Places the natural logarithm of two on the diagram. |
| [Ln Pi](other_constants/ln_pi.md) | Places the natural logarithm of Pi on the diagram. |
| [Log10(e)](other_constants/log10_e.md) | Places the base-10 logarithm of Euler's number on the diagram. |
| [Ideal Gas Constant](other_constants/ideal_gas.md) | Places the molar ideal gas constant on the diagram. |
| [Elementary Charge](other_constants/elementary_charge.md) | Places the elementary electric charge constant on the diagram. |
| [Avogadro Constant](other_constants/avogadro.md) | Places the Avogadro constant on the diagram. |
| [Rydberg Constant](other_constants/rydberg.md) | Places the Rydberg constant on the diagram. |
| [Gravitational Constant](other_constants/gravitational.md) | Places the Newtonian gravitational constant on the diagram. |
| [Planck Constant](other_constants/planck.md) | Places the Planck constant on the diagram. |
| [Speed of Light](other_constants/speed_of_light.md) | Places the speed of light in vacuum on the diagram. |
